title: 第20章 开炉炼丹第21章 鄂珑再临
content_zh:
接下来的日子，徐长生过得极为充实。
白天，他在丹房里跟着云长老学习炼丹之术，从最基本的控火开始，一点一点地磨练。
晚上，他便在偏房里研读《灵药真解》和慕容月的炼丹心得，将白天学到的东西反复消化。
云长老虽然面冷，但教起人来却极为认真。
“控火，是炼丹的根本。”云长老站在丹炉前，手中掐诀，地火随着他的法诀时大时小，变化万千。
“火大了，药性被焚，废丹。火小了，药性不融，也是废丹。只有火候恰到好处，药材中的灵气才能完美融合，凝而成丹。”
“炼丹第一步，便是控火，你来试试。”
徐长生坐到丹炉前，学着云长老的样子，掐动法诀。
体内灵气涌动，缓缓注入地火之中。
地火在他的操控下缓缓燃起，起初还算平稳，但没过多久便开始忽大忽小，难以控制。
“灵气不稳。”云长老站在一旁，淡淡道，“你的修为太低，灵气不足以支撑长时间控火。这是硬伤，短时间内无法弥补。”
徐长生沉默。
练气五层的修为，在杂役中算是佼佼者，但对于炼丹来说，确实远远不够。
“不过……”云长老话锋一转，“你对火候的感知倒是极为敏锐。火大火小，你都能第一时间察觉到。这一点，即便是很多二品炼丹师也做不到。”
徐长生知道，这是丹心的功劳。
但他不能说出来，只是恭声道：“弟子会继续努力。”
云长老点了点头，没有再说什么。
日子一天天过去。
徐长生的控火之术进步神速，短短七天，便已经能稳定地控制地火的大小变化。
云长老看在眼里，心中暗暗惊讶。

这样的进步速度，即便是在那些单灵根的天才弟子身上，也不多见。
“能在七天时间，就掌控火候大小，如臂指使，你在炼丹一道上，果然天赋不凡。”
“在熟悉三天，第十天，进行第二步，投药。”
这是徐长生接触炼丹的第十天。
也是他开炉炼丹的日子。
徐长生深吸一口气，重重点了点头，将处理好的药材一一摆在面前。
赤焰果、冰心莲、月见草、地龙根。
这是补充灵气的几种丹方中，比较常见的几种药材。
聚气丹，聚元丹，聚灵丹……都需要这些药材。
而后几种丹药，除此之外，需要的药材种类更多一些。
按照《基础炼丹法》的要求，投药的顺序是：先投月见草，再投地龙根，然后同时投入赤焰果和冰心莲。
徐长生掐动法诀，地火燃起，丹炉内的温度缓缓升高。
content_en:
In the days that followed, Xu Changsheng lived an extremely fulfilling life.
During the day, he studied alchemy techniques with Elder Yun in the alchemy room, starting from the most basic fire control and honing it bit by bit.
At night, he would study "The True Explanation of Spiritual Medicine" and Murong Yue's alchemy experience in the side room, and digest what he learned during the day.
Although Elder Yun has a cold face, he is extremely serious in teaching people.
"Controlling fire is the foundation of alchemy." Elder Yun stood in front of the alchemy furnace, making magic formulas in his hands. The earthly fire became larger and smaller with his magic formulas, changing in countless ways.
"If the fire is strong, the medicinal properties will be burned, and the elixir will be wasted. If the fire is low, the medicinal properties will not melt, and the elixir will be wasted. Only when the fire is just right, can the spiritual energy in the medicinal materials be perfectly integrated and condensed into an elixir."
"The first step in alchemy is to control fire. Come and try it."
Xu Changsheng sat in front of the alchemy furnace and imitated Elder Yun's example, using the magic formula.
The spiritual energy in his body surged and slowly poured into the earth fire.
The ground fire slowly ignited under his control. It was relatively stable at first, but it didn't take long before it began to wax and wane, making it difficult to control.
"The spiritual energy is unstable." Elder Yun stood aside and said calmly, "Your cultivation level is too low, and the spiritual energy is not enough to support fire control for a long time. This is a flaw that cannot be made up for in a short time."
Xu Changsheng was silent.
The cultivation of the fifth level of Qi training is considered outstanding among handymen, but for alchemy, it is indeed far from enough.
"But..." Elder Yun changed the subject, "Your perception of fire is extremely keen. You can detect a small fire immediately. Even many second-grade alchemists cannot do this."
Xu Changsheng knew that this was due to his loyalty.
But he couldn't say it out loud. He just said respectfully: "Disciple will continue to work hard."
Elder Yun nodded and said nothing more.
The days passed.
Xu Changsheng's fire control skills improved rapidly. In just seven days, he was able to stably control the changes in the size of the ground fire.
Elder Yun saw this and was secretly surprised.
Such a speed of progress is rare even among those genius disciples with single spiritual roots.
"You can control the size of the fire in just seven days, and you can control it like an arm. You are really talented in alchemy."
"After three days of familiarization, on the tenth day, proceed to the second step, administer the medicine."
This was the tenth day that Xu Changsheng came into contact with alchemy.
It was also the day when he started refining alchemy.
Xu Changsheng took a deep breath, nodded heavily, and placed the prepared medicinal materials in front of him one by one.
Red flame fruit, ice lotus, evening primrose, earth dragon root.
These are some of the more common medicinal materials among several elixirs for replenishing spiritual energy.
Qi Gathering Pill, Yuan Gathering Pill, Spirit Gathering Pill... all require these medicinal materials.
In addition to the latter several types of elixirs, more types of medicinal materials are needed.
According to the requirements of "Basic Alchemy Method", the order of adding medicine is: first add evening primrose, then add earth dragon root, and then add red flame fruit and ice heart lotus at the same time.
Xu Changsheng pinched the magic formula, the ground fire ignited, and the temperature in the alchemy furnace slowly increased.
